The '''Mynock''' was a model of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
